scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there, I recently applied for a housing loan and I'm curious about the status of my application. Can you help me with that?
dialogue.agent: Your application for a loan of $85,000 with a 40-year term was denied. The principal reason for the denial was your debt-to-income ratio.

dialogue.user: I see. Can you tell me what my debt-to-income ratio was and how it affected my application? Also, is there any specific reason why my debt-to-income ratio was considered too high?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio was 48%. This ratio is the percentage of your monthly income that goes toward paying debts. Lenders use this to assess your ability to manage monthly payments. The record does not include underwriting rationale, so I cannot provide specific reasons why your ratio was considered too high.

dialogue.user: I understand. Can you tell me if there are any other reasons for the denial or if this was the sole reason? Also, is there any way I can improve my chances of getting approved in the future?
dialogue.agent: The only reason for the denial was your debt-to-income ratio. To improve your chances of approval in the future, you may consider reducing your debt or increasing your income to lower your debt-to-income ratio.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. I appreciate your help. <Neutral> The conversation was informative, but I wish there was more specific advice on how to improve my chances of approval.
